root_cause.text: Missing bounds check on `rc_curpage` before indexing into `rqstp->rq_pages[]`, allowing out-of-bounds access when processing inline data with multiple Read chunks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an explicit check `if (head->rc_curpage >= rqstp->rq_maxpages) return -EINVAL;` in `svc_rdma_copy_inline_range`, and the commit message states that the function "indexed rqstp->rq_pages[rc_curpage] without verifying rc_curpage stays within the allocated page array."

intent_record.intent_summary: Add guard against exceeding maximum page count in svc_rdma_copy_inline_range to prevent out-of-bounds access.
intent_record.what: Added a check in the loop inside svc_rdma_copy_inline_range to ensure head->rc_curpage is less than rqstp->rq_maxpages; if not, return -EINVAL.
intent_record.how: Prevents accessing an invalid page index beyond the allocated maximum, avoiding out-of-bounds memory access and potential crashes.
